Interface EMFModelValidator.Factory

Enclosing interface:
EMFModelValidator
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface EMFModelValidator.Factory
Factory for validators used by an EMFModelGenerator.

The generator supplies its exact ResourceSet as validation context. Implementations that depend on resource-set-local state may use it; validators that do not require such context may ignore it. The model roots to validate are supplied separately through EMFModelValidator.validate(EObject) or EMFModelValidator.validateAll(Collection).

Author:
Lorenzo Bettini
